text.en: Wash leeks carefully between the leaves.
text.de: Lauch sorgfältig zwischen den Blättern waschen.

why.en: Sandy soil gets in between the leaves.
why.de: Zwischen die Blätter gerät sandige Erde.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 3 Vegetables, section 3.7 Mushrooms, Truffles and Onions
sources.sentence: Leeks must be carefully washed to remove the sandy soil that gets between the leaves.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter A Survey of Common Vegetables, Leeks, p. 313
sources.sentence: This practice also fills the spaces between leaves with grit, and necessitates careful washing.

sources.title: Der junge Koch / Die junge Köchin (Brandes, Harten, Krödel, Voll, Wolffgang), 38th edition, Pfanneberg 2022
sources.place: Zubereiten einfacher Speisen - 1 Gemüse, Lauch/Porree, p. 320
sources.sentence: Nun wird der Porree längs halbiert, um ihn unter fließendem Wasser zu waschen.
